{"target_smiles":"Cc1cnc(NCCc2cccc(CN(C)C)c2)c(=O)n1CC(=O)O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线针对目标吡嗪酮衍生物分子采取汇聚式合成策略。首先切断末端羧酸侧链上的保护基，通过叔丁基酯酸性水解构建最终的游离羧酸结构。核心骨架的构建基于3-位亲核芳香取代反应（SN-Ar），将3-氯吡嗪-2(1H)-酮片段与间位取代的苯乙胺侧链片段进行偶联。对于吡嗪酮母核，由商业可得的2,3-二氯-5-甲基吡嗪经选择性单水解获得3-氯-6-甲基吡嗪-2(1H)-酮，随后在碱性条件下利用溴乙酸叔丁酯对内酰胺N-1位进行化学选择性烷基化构建。侧链胺片段则由3-甲酰基苯乙腈与二甲胺经还原胺化引入二甲氨基甲基，再通过催化氢化选择性还原脂肪族腈基得到目标伯胺。该路线原料均廉价易得且重原子数均在12以内，巧妙规避了游离羧酸和二甲氨基对杂环亲核取代的潜在干扰，具有高步骤经济性与良好的化学选择性。","key_disconnection_class":"tert-butyl ester deprotection","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"吡嗪酮烷基化、SNAr偶联与酯水解","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cnc(NCCc2cccc(CN(C)C)c2)c(=O)n1CC(=O)O","precursors":["Cc1cnc(NCCc2cccc(CN(C)C)c2)c(=O)n1CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C"],"reaction_class":"tert-butyl ester deprotection"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cnc(NCCc2cccc(CN(C)C)c2)c(=O)n1CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C","precursors":["Cc1cnc(Cl)c(=O)n1CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C","CN(C)Cc1cccc(CCN)c1"],"reaction_class":"nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Cc1cnc(Cl)c(=O)n1CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C","precursors":["Cc1cnc(Cl)c(=O)[nH]1","CC(C)(C)OC(=O)CBr"],"reaction_class":"alkylation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Cc1cnc(Cl)c(=O)[nH]1","precursors":["Cc1cnc(Cl)c(Cl)n1"],"reaction_class":"hydrolysis"},{"step_id":5,"product":"CN(C)Cc1cccc(CCN)c1","precursors":["CN(C)Cc1cccc(CC#N)c1"],"reaction_class":"nitrile reduction"},{"step_id":6,"product":"CN(C)Cc1cccc(CC#N)c1","precursors":["N#CCc1cccc(C=O)c1","CNC"],"reaction_class":"reductive amination"}],"starting_materials":["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)CBr","CNC","Cc1cnc(Cl)c(Cl)n1","N#CCc1cccc(C=O)c1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Nc1cccc(-c2ccc3ccn(-c4ccnc(N)n4)c3c2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标分子4-(6-(3-氨基苯基)-1H-吲哚-1-基)嘧啶-2-胺进行逆合成分析。核心策略采用汇聚式偶联组装。首先切断3-氨基苯基与吲哚6位之间的碳碳双芳基键，该断键将分子拆解为两个结构显著简化的核心砌块：4-(6-溴-1H-吲哚-1-基)嘧啶-2-胺和3-氨基苯基硼酸。该断键的优势在于能够在合成最终步利用高化学选择性的Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联反应实现片段拼接，避免游离苯胺氨基在早期步骤中发生非预期的亲核取代或竞争性副反应。第二步断键针对吲哚N1位与2-氨基嘧啶4位之间的碳氮键，拆解为商业可得的6-溴-1H-吲哚与4-氯嘧啶-2-胺。在此步Buchwald-Hartwig胺化或碱促进的亲核芳香取代中，吲哚阴离子表现出优良亲核性，嘧啶4位氯原子的亲电离去活性优于2位氨基，具有良好的化学与区域选择性。所有起始原料均为十二个重原子以内的商业化试剂，整条路线简短、原子经济性高且无需保护基操作。","key_disconnection_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":2,"strategy":"Suzuki偶联构建双芳基与Buchwald胺化构建CN键","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Nc1cccc(-c2ccc3ccn(-c4ccnc(N)n4)c3c2)c1","precursors":["Nc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","Nc1cccc(B(O)O)c1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Nc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","precursors":["Brc1ccc2cc[nH]c2c1","Nc1nccc(Cl)n1"],"reaction_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination"}],"starting_materials":["Brc1ccc2cc[nH]c2c1","Nc1cccc(B(O)O)c1","Nc1nccc(Cl)n1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Nc1cccc(-c2ccc3ccn(-c4ccnc(N)n4)c3c2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"该逆合成路线采取高度汇聚的模块化组装策略。首先切断目标分子中3-氨基苯基与吲哚6位之间的碳-碳键，这一关键断键将复杂的三芳基骨架高效简化为3-氨基苯基硼酸和4-(6-溴-1H-吲哚-1-基)嘧啶-2-胺两个核心片段。主要合成挑战在于后期偶联时的化学选择性控制，需确保底物中嘧啶环上的游离氨基在钯催化交叉偶联条件下不发生干扰；采用温和的Suzuki-Miyaura反应可在无需保护基的情况下实现高化学选择性的芳基化。对于4-(6-溴-1H-吲哚-1-基)嘧啶-2-胺中间体，逆向切断嘧啶2位氨基和吲哚N1-嘧啶C4键，回溯至6-溴吲哚与2,4-二氯嘧啶。利用2,4-二氯嘧啶C4位相比C2位具有显著更高的亲核芳香取代活性，首先使吲哚钠盐高区域选择性进攻C4位构筑C-N键，随后利用氨水置换C2位氯原子引入氨基，成功规避了使用2-氨基-4-氯嘧啶可能引起的氨基副反应。路线最终所有原料均为廉价易得的十碳以下商业化试剂。","key_disconnection_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":3,"strategy":"Suzuki偶联构建联芳基骨架","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Nc1cccc(-c2ccc3ccn(-c4ccnc(N)n4)c3c2)c1","precursors":["Nc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","Nc1cccc(B(O)O)c1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Nc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","precursors":["Clc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","N"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Clc1nccc(-n2ccc3ccc(Br)cc32)n1","precursors":["Brc1ccc2cc[nH]c2c1","Clc1ccnc(Cl)n1"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"}],"starting_materials":["Brc1ccc2cc[nH]c2c1","Clc1ccnc(Cl)n1","N","Nc1cccc(B(O)O)c1"]}]}

route_text: {"target_smiles":"OCc1nn(C2CCCCO2)c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线以商业易得的3-氟苯酚和苄溴为起始原料，通过高效的线性与收敛结合策略构建目标分子。逆合成分析首先将目标物C3位羟甲基切断为对应的乙酯前体，通过温和的酯还原反应完成目标分子的安装；在还原前，吲唑N1位通过与二氢吡喃（DHP）反应安装THP保护基，以确保化学选择性。核心吲唑骨架的构建采用经典高效的邻氟苯基α-酮酸酯与水合肼的缩合及原位分子内SNAr芳香亲核取代环化反应，高区域选择性地闭环形成吲唑环。关键的α-酮酸酯中间体通过1-(苄氧基)-3-氟苯与草酰氯单乙酯的傅-克酰基化反应引入，由于苄氧基（强供电子基）与氟原子协同定位，酰化专一发生在苄氧基的对位。最初的芳基醚前体由3-氟苯酚与苄溴经威廉姆森醚化一步制得。全路线仅需5步，原料廉价易得且均为12重原子以下的小分子，避免了复杂的保护基操作。","key_disconnection_class":"Ester reduction","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"基于邻氟酮酸酯肼化环化构建吲唑核心骨架","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"OCc1nn(C2CCCCO2)c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12","precursors":["CCOC(=O)c1nn(C2CCCCO2)c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12"],"reaction_class":"Ester reduction"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CCOC(=O)c1nn(C2CCCCO2)c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12","precursors":["CCOC(=O)c1n[nH]c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12","C1=COCCC1"],"reaction_class":"THP protection"},{"step_id":3,"product":"CCOC(=O)c1n[nH]c2cc(OCc3ccccc3)ccc12","precursors":["CCOC(=O)C(=O)c1ccc(OCc2ccccc2)cc1F","NN"],"reaction_class":"Hydrazine cyclization"},{"step_id":4,"product":"CCOC(=O)C(=O)c1ccc(OCc2ccccc2)cc1F","precursors":["Fc1cccc(OCc2ccccc2)c1","CCOC(=O)C(=O)Cl"],"reaction_class":"Friedel-Crafts acylation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Fc1cccc(OCc2ccccc2)c1","precursors":["Oc1cccc(F)c1","BrCc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"}],"starting_materials":["BrCc1ccccc1","C1=COCCC1","CCOC(=O)C(=O)Cl","NN","Oc1cccc(F)c1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(-c4ccncn4)c(-c4ccco4)nc3[nH]2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线以高度汇聚且化学选择性明确的策略合成目标多取代7-氮杂吲哚衍生物。首先在终末阶段利用C6位与C5位卤素的反应性差异，进行顺序的钯催化Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联反应。首步断开C6位的2-呋喃基，利用6-氯-7-氮杂吲哚前体与2-呋喃硼酸偶联引入；在此之前，利用C5位溴原子比C6位氯原子更高的氧化加成活性，选择性地与嘧啶-5-基硼酸发生Suzuki偶联引入C5位杂芳基。7-氮杂吲哚双环核心骨架则通过经典的Sonogashira偶联与随后的5-endo-dig分子内环化构筑：以5-溴-6-氯-3-碘吡啶-2-胺与间氟苯乙炔为原料，利用C3-I在温和条件下相较于Br和Cl的极高化学选择性实现单偶联，继而在碱或铜催化下关环构筑2-(3-氟苯基)吡咯并吡啶母核。关键吡啶中间体5-溴-6-氯-3-碘吡啶-2-胺由商业可得的大宗原料6-氯吡啶-2-胺经两步区域选择性亲电卤化（NBS溴化与NIS碘化）高效制备。整条路线充分利用了I大于Br大于Cl的卤素反应活性层级，避免了保护基操作，具有极高的化学选择性与步骤经济性。","key_disconnection_class":"Suzuki coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"顺序卤素交叉偶联与炔胺环化构筑7-氮杂吲哚","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(-c4ccncn4)c(-c4ccco4)nc3[nH]2)c1","precursors":["Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(-c4ccncn4)c(Cl)nc3[nH]2)c1","OB(O)c1ccco1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(-c4ccncn4)c(Cl)nc3[nH]2)c1","precursors":["Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(Br)c(Cl)nc3[nH]2)c1","OB(O)c1ccncn1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki coupling"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Fc1cccc(-c2cc3cc(Br)c(Cl)nc3[nH]2)c1","precursors":["Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1C#Cc1cccc(F)c1"],"reaction_class":"5-endo-dig cyclization"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1C#Cc1cccc(F)c1","precursors":["Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1I","C#Cc1cccc(F)c1"],"reaction_class":"Sonogashira coupling"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1I","precursors":["Nc1ccc(Br)c(Cl)n1"],"reaction_class":"Halogenation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"Nc1ccc(Br)c(Cl)n1","precursors":["Nc1cccc(Cl)n1"],"reaction_class":"Halogenation"}],"starting_materials":["C#Cc1cccc(F)c1","Nc1cccc(Cl)n1","OB(O)c1ccco1","OB(O)c1ccncn1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"O=C(CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2)n1ccnc1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标分子中活泼的酰基咪唑官能团和取代四氢异喹啉核心结构，采取汇聚式逆合成策略。首先在最终步切断酰基咪唑的碳氮键，通过游离咪唑与羧酸中间体的酰胺缩合反应构建目标物，该设计避免了活泼酰基咪唑在早期多步转化中发生水解或亲核副反应的风险。向后追溯，羧酸前体由相应的乙酯经温和碱性水解制得。乙酯中间体的醚键则通过四氢异喹啉酚羟基与4-溴丁酸乙酯在碱性条件下的Williamson醚化反应形成。核心四氢异喹啉母核上的环丁基侧链，通过四氢异喹啉酚与环丁酮的还原胺化反应高效引入。路线的核心挑战在于四氢异喹啉酚羟基与二级胺的化学选择性区分，由于脂肪族仲胺亲核性显著强于酚羟基，还原胺化专一发生于氮原子上，后续醚化选择性良好。全路线原料均小于12个重原子且商业易得，合成简洁高效。","key_disconnection_class":"amide coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"酰基咪唑偶联与还原胺化汇聚合成","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"O=C(CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2)n1ccnc1","precursors":["O=C(O)CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","c1c[nH]cn1"],"reaction_class":"amide coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"O=C(O)CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","precursors":["CCOC(=O)CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2"],"reaction_class":"ester hydrolysis"},{"step_id":3,"product":"CCOC(=O)CCCOc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","precursors":["Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","CCOC(=O)CCCBr"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","precursors":["Oc1ccc2c(c1)CNCC2","O=C1CCC1"],"reaction_class":"reductive amination"}],"starting_materials":["CCOC(=O)CCCBr","O=C1CCC1","Oc1ccc2c(c1)CNCC2","c1c[nH]cn1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"Cc1cc(C(Cc2ccccc2)=NOCc2ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc2)ccc1OCC(=O)NCC(=O)O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标化合物的结构特征采用高度汇聚式的逆合成策略。首先切断末端的甘氨酸酰胺键，将分子拆解为带有完整肟醚骨架的苯氧乙酸母核与商业甘氨酸，显著简化分子复杂性。主片段苯氧乙酸衍生物进一步逆切肟醚碳氮双键，分为4-酰基苯氧乙酸酮片段和对三氟甲基苄基羟胺侧链。酮片段通过酚羟基醚化逆切至4-(2-苯乙酰基)-2-甲基苯酚，该酚类中间体可由廉价易得的邻甲酚与苯乙酰氯经高对位选择性的Friedel-Crafts酰化一步构筑。对三氟甲基苄基羟胺侧链则由4-三氟甲基溴苄与Boc保护的羟胺经烷基化及脱保护平稳制得。路线的核心挑战在于酰化反应的区域选择性控制以及肟醚缩合时的几何异构控制。整条路线原料廉价且均在12重原子以内，步骤精简高效。","key_disconnection_class":"amide coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"酰胺偶联汇聚合成苯氧乙酸衍生物","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"Cc1cc(C(Cc2ccccc2)=NOCc2ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc2)ccc1OCC(=O)NCC(=O)O","precursors":["Cc1cc(C(Cc2ccccc2)=NOCc2ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc2)ccc1OCC(=O)O","NCC(=O)O"],"reaction_class":"amide coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cc(C(Cc2ccccc2)=NOCc2ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc2)ccc1OCC(=O)O","precursors":["Cc1cc(C(=O)Cc2ccccc2)ccc1OCC(=O)O","NOCc1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1"],"reaction_class":"condensation"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Cc1cc(C(=O)Cc2ccccc2)ccc1OCC(=O)O","precursors":["Cc1cc(C(=O)Cc2ccccc2)ccc1O","O=C(O)CBr"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Cc1cc(C(=O)Cc2ccccc2)ccc1O","precursors":["Cc1ccccc1O","O=C(Cl)Cc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Friedel-Crafts acylation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"NOCc1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1","precursors":["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NOCc1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Boc deprotection"},{"step_id":6,"product":"CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NOCc1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1","precursors":["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NO","FC(F)(F)c1ccc(CBr)cc1"],"reaction_class":"nucleophilic substitution"}],"starting_materials":["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NO","Cc1ccccc1O","FC(F)(F)c1ccc(CBr)cc1","NCC(=O)O","O=C(Cl)Cc1ccccc1","O=C(O)CBr"]}]}
